articles.title: India's largest crypto exchange absorbs $16 million loss from internal process failure tied to retired wallet
articles.snippet: The Mumbai-based exchange initially dismissed reports of suspicious outflows as a false alarm. It now says it lost $16 million and will absorb the loss.

articles.title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
articles.snippet: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs.

articles.title: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
articles.snippet: As part of the potential implementation of its Stablecoin Act, the Canadian government will hear from the public on a proposed framework for tokens from non-financial institutions.

articles.title: Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions
articles.snippet: Ahead of elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel could turn to blockchain and crypto to skirt potential international sanctions, to the dismay of opponents and the country’s central banker.

articles.title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
articles.snippet: The blockchain suspended its layer-1 network and rollups after security researchers identified unauthorized token minting and millions in assets transferred to Ethereum.
